name: vornik
description: Plugins for integrating Claude Code (and other host LLM clients) with a vornik daemon. Today: the async-offload companion plugin documented in LLD 21. Future entries will cover Codex / Gemini-CLI / opencode adapters and the reverse-direction A2A bridge.

plugins.name: vornik-companion
plugins.description: Async-offload companion. Delegate reviews, audits, validations, research, summarization, and bulk RAG ingest to vornik-managed agents over MCP; results re-enter Claude's context via a SessionStart digest hook. Per-repo scoping (migration 75) so one project's RAG cleanly serves multiple repos. Also bundles an operator lifecycle triad of skills — configure-vornik, troubleshoot-vornik, and report-problem — so your assistant drives Vornik's own tooling (config validate/reload, the doctor, the failure-class playbook, and the anonymized problem reporter) instead of improvising.
